params.identityCommitment: The voter's Semaphore identity commitment,        generated client-side. The secret behind it never leaves the browser.

params.signature: 65-byte ECDSA (r, s, v) from an EOA, or anything a        contract wallet accepts via ERC-1271.

params.proof: Semaphore proof whose `message` is packRanking(ranking)        and whose `scope` is this election's scope.

MAX_CANDIDATES().notice: A full ranking must fit in one uint256 message, one byte per rank.

REGISTER_TYPEHASH().notice: EIP-712 type a wallet signs to let anyone register its commitment.         No nonce: the domain binds the signature to this election, and each         wallet can register only once.

ballots().notice: Every distinct packed ballot and how many times it was cast, so         anyone can recount the runoff off-chain.

commitments().notice: All registered identity commitments, in the order they were added to         the Merkle tree (what a voter needs to rebuild the group off-chain).

creator().notice: Gets back whatever relayer funding is left once voting has ended.         Has no other power: the election itself still has no admin.

domainSeparator().notice: EIP-712 domain separator. Computed live so it follows block.chainid.

maxRefundGasPrice().notice: Gas refunds use min(tx.gasprice, this). Without a cap, a relayer could         bid an absurd gas price and have the election pay for it. 0 = no refund.

minAnonymitySet().notice: Votes are refused unless at least this many wallets registered.

packRanking(uint256[]).notice: Canonical uint256 encoding of a ranking, used as the proof's message.         Reverts unless the ranking has 1..n distinct, valid candidate indices.

reclaim().notice: After voting ends, send the unused funding back to the creator. Anyone         can call it; what relayers are owed stays in the contract.

registerDigest(address,uint256).notice: The digest `wallet` signs to authorize registerFor.

registerFor(address,uint256,bytes).notice: Register on behalf of `wallet`, which signed         Register(wallet, identityCommitment) off-chain (EIP-712). Anyone can         submit it (e.g. a relayer paying gas); they can't change the commitment.

relayBounty().notice: Paid to the relayer on top of the gas refund, per relayed registration         and per counted vote (in wei of the native token). 0 = no bounty.

relayFunds().notice: Funding not yet promised to a relayer.

scope().notice: Semaphore scope for this election. The nullifier is derived from         (scope, identity secret), so it is unique per voter per election         and unlinkable across elections.

tally().notice: Live votes per candidate (first preferences for ranked ballots);         cannot be hidden by construction.

winners().notice: Final result: every winning candidate index (more than one = tie).

withdraw().notice: Collect everything this contract owes the caller.
